The '''''Capital''-class starship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel]] and [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries/Legends|Gwori Revolutionary Industries]]. The ship was shaped with a flat underbelly and elongated pod. Powerful [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceiver]] arrays were housed on the lateral wing, which transected the hull of the ship.<ref name=":0">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==History==
In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], a newly-constructed ''Capital''-class vessel transported [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] and [[Larsh Hill]] from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
The description of the ''Capital''-class is similar to that of the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era vessel also produced by Hoersch-Kessel and Gwori. The ''Capital''-class may have been a predecessor to the ''Munificent''-class.
